Schedules the game to exit in the next frame (or immediately if immediately is true).

protected virtual void PerformExit(bool immediately)

Parameters

immediately bool

If true, exits the game immediately. If false (default), schedules the game to exit in the next frame.

Remarks

Will never be called if osu.Framework.Platform.GameHost.CanExit is false.

PresentFileExternally(string)

Requests to present a file externally in the platform's native file browser.

public abstract bool PresentFileExternally(string filename)

Parameters

filename string

The absolute path to the file/folder to be shown in its parent folder.

Returns

bool

Whether the file was successfully presented.

Examples

"C:\Windows\explorer.exe" -> opens 'C:\Windows' and highlights 'explorer.exe' in the window.

"C:\Windows\System32" -> opens 'C:\Windows' and highlights 'System32' in the window.

Remarks

This will open the parent folder and, (if available) highlight the file. Some platforms do not support interacting with files externally (ie. mobile or sandboxed platforms), check the return value to discern whether it succeeded.

If a folder path is provided to this method, it will prefer highlighting the folder in the parent folder, rather than showing the contents. To display the contents of a folder, use osu.Framework.Platform.GameHost.OpenFileExternally(System.String) instead.

bool

true if the game was successfully suspended and minimized.

Remarks

This is provided as an alternative to osu.Framework.Platform.GameHost.Exit on hosts that can't exit (see osu.Framework.Platform.GameHost.CanExit). Should only be called if osu.Framework.Platform.GameHost.CanSuspendToBackground is true.
